dataConditions.pendingProgress: no orphaned/interrupted record for the requested logical task; current-session queue-owned rows do not count
dataConditions.queueOwnedProgress: may exist for a running, queued, or paused current-session job; it suppresses recovery UI without implying a fresh start

expectedSemantics.dialogHidden: No recovery prompt. Start fresh from index 0 only when neither an orphaned/interrupted record nor a current-session queue-owned row exists; otherwise the existing queue-owned job continues.
